question: Which of the following numbers best describes the number of white pieces used in chess?
solution:
The correct answer is __**16**__.

 
• In chess, each player starts with 16 pieces.
 
• The 16 pieces for each side include: **1 King, 1 Queen, 2 Rooks, 2 Knights, 2 Bishops, and 8 Pawns**.
 
• White and Black both have identical sets of pieces at the start of the game.
 
• The objective of chess is to checkmate the opponent's King while strategically using all pieces.

 
• **King:**

 
 
• The King is the most important piece, but it is not very powerful. It can only move one square in any direction.
